title: Product JSON-LD contract — Al-Amoudi Furniture
description: Emitted by src/app/products/[id]/page.tsx via ProductSchema. CRITICAL: aggregateRating MUST NOT appear unless populated from a verified reviews pipeline (Constitution III).

offers.description: Present only when product.price is defined. Contains shipping + return policy with current logic in JsonLd.tsx unchanged.

aggregateRating.description: FORBIDDEN unless real, verified reviews exist. JSON.stringify drops undefined keys, so when the prop is omitted, this field MUST NOT appear in the rendered JSON-LD.

forbidden: Any aggregateRating object whose ratingValue/reviewCount is hardcoded in component source.
Any review[] entries that are not sourced from a verified reviews pipeline.
constitutional_references: Constitution Principle III — No Black-Hat / No Fake Signals.
